title: Live: College Football
description: The Tar Heels break away from their ACC schedule by visiting the independent Huskies. North Carolina led early in the fourth quarter before succumbing to No. 1 Miami 38-35 on Halloween. UConn won the last meeting, 27-14 in the 2024 Fenway Bowl.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Temple Owls (2-6) face the Navy Midshipmen (2-6) at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium. Temple seeks to end a three-game losing streak after falling 17-9 to East Carolina, while Navy seeks to snap a skid as well after falling 35-13 to Notre Dame.

title: Live: College Football
description: First meets worst as the Gamecocks (6-2, 4-0 Conference USA) host the Bearkats (1-7, 0-4). Jacksonville State has won three consecutive meetings. Gamecocks dual-threat quarterback Caden Creel has thrown 13 touchdown passes and rushed for five scores.

title: Live: College Football
description: UNLV Rebels meet Wyoming Cowboys at Allegiant Stadium. UNLV relies on scoring from a 31-24 victory on Nov 1, while Wyoming counts on defensive takeaways after recovering three fumbles in a 28-14 win on Oct 24 to claim a Mountain West victory.
